Agbrio 把操作交给精确绑定的对话，检查权限并保留回执；可执行哪些操作，以实: Agbrio routes actions to the exact bound conversation, checks permissions, and keeps receipts. Available actions depend on the capabilities actually discovered.

接入 MCP 不会自动启动后台助手。持续提醒、自动跟进和定时汇报，还需客户端支持: Connecting MCP does not start a background assistant. Ongoing alerts, automatic follow-up, and scheduled reports need client support and separate setup. Keep your computer on, online, and Agbrio running.

Claude Code 接入三步: Connect Claude Code in three steps
终端或 VS Code：先运行 claude mcp get agbrio 检查: Terminal or VS Code: check claude mcp get agbrio first. If the connection is missing, copy the PowerShell command below.
桌面 Code：输入框旁 + → Add connectors，或 Settin: Desktop Code: use + beside the prompt → Add connectors, or Settings → Connectors, to add the custom MCP URL. Verify it in the session you will use.
终端输入 /mcp，选择 agbrio 完成登录；桌面端在连接器中授权。已有有效: In the terminal, open /mcp and select agbrio to sign in. On Desktop, authorize the connector. A valid existing login may be reused without another popup.
实际调用才算连接成功: Verify with an actual tool call
让助手实际调用 agbrio_read_app，报告权限范围、有效期和读取结果。: Ask the assistant to call agbrio_read_app and report the scope, expiry and read result. Pasting instructions, saving configuration or having a grant does not prove this session is connected.
MCP 连接请看 /mcp 或连接器，不一定出现在插件列表。管理 Codex 用: Find the MCP connection in /mcp or Connectors; it may not appear in Plugins. MCP manages Codex. To monitor Claude in Agbrio or receive native notices, connect the separate Claude bridge plugin.
先添加授权，再到你要使用的助手中连接 MCP。: Add a grant, then connect MCP in the assistant you want to use.
要把 Codex 完成通知送回 Claude，或从手机回复 Claude 原对话: Enable the local connection to send Codex completion notices back to Claude or reply to the original Claude chat from your phone. MCP still handles reads and task dispatch.
启用 Claude 通知与手机回复: Enable Claude notices and phone replies
请在电脑端 Agbrio 的同一页面启用本机连接，再回到 Claude 管理对话: Enable the local connection on this same page in desktop Agbrio, then verify it in the Claude management chat.
已收到 Claude 连接心跳。还需在管理会话登记具体任务的完成通知。: A Claude heartbeat was received. Register the specific task notice in the management session before expecting it.
本机连接已准备。请在空闲的 Claude 管理会话执行 /reload-plug: The local connection is prepared. Run /reload-plugins in the Claude management session when idle, then check the connection.
需要通知时，让管理助手实际发现 codex_wait：先查看 status，再为: For a requested notice, the manager must discover codex_wait, inspect status, then register wait for the exact delegated turn. Require a WAITING receipt before promising notification. Other chats are not subscribed automatically.
Claude 插件仍是旧版，更新尚未确认。请检查插件更新后重试。: The Claude plugin is still outdated; its update was not confirmed. Check the plugin update and try again.
无法确认 Claude 插件版本，尚未启用新的连接。: The Claude plugin version could not be verified. No new connection was enabled.
Claude 插件尚未确认启用，请检查插件状态。: The Claude plugin was not confirmed enabled. Check its status.
MCP 连接请看 /mcp 或连接器，不一定出现在插件列表。要让完成通知回到 C: Find the MCP connection in /mcp or Connectors; it may not appear in Plugins. Continue with the local connection below for completion notices back to Claude and phone replies to its original chat.
首次使用不用预装插件。点击下方按钮会安装、启用并配置内置 Claude 组件，用: First use needs no preinstalled plugin. The button installs, enables and configures the bundled Claude component for notices and phone replies. MCP reads and dispatch can be used first.
安装并连接 Claude 完整功能: Install and connect Claude full features
网页和手机不能安装本机组件。请打开已安装的 Windows Agbrio 客户端: Web and phone cannot install local components. Open the installed Windows Agbrio client and install on this page; do not run /reload-plugins first.
安装与配置已完成，尚待当前会话加载。请等 Claude 管理会话空闲后执行 /r: Installation and configuration are complete; loading in this session is still pending. Run /reload-plugins when the Claude management session is idle, then check the connection.
MCP 连接请看 /mcp 或连接器，不一定出现在插件列表。要让完成通知回到 C: Find the MCP connection in /mcp or Connectors; it may not appear in Plugins. Use the install-and-connect button above for completion notices back to Claude and phone replies to its original chat.
未找到 Claude Code 内置引擎。请先打开 Claude 桌面应用的 C: Could not find the bundled Claude Code engine. Open a local session in the Claude desktop app’s Code tab and retry. If Code already works, provide its /status version and engine path.
Claude Code 内置引擎版本低于 2.1.286，请更新 Claude: The bundled Claude Code engine is older than 2.1.286. Update the Claude desktop app and retry.
